assumptions: the same W satisfies the frozen CRR separation/cardinality/energy conditions and RationalMass(v)
actual_log_conditional_gate.common_object_rule: The same W supplies M_W, RationalMass, the actual Farey kernel, and the capped coefficient b^ph; no separately optimized coefficient or row set is used.
actual_log_conditional_gate.conclusion: For all sufficiently large v, b^ph has |b_n^ph|<=1 and min_(t in W)|(M_W b^ph)_t|>=v^(7-delta(v)).
actual_log_conditional_gate.farey_preservation: The actual reduced labels, bounded jitter, rays, and C_theta(sk,rk)=R_W((r/s)*exp(theta/H)) identity remain untouched; no generic alias model is substituted.
actual_log_conditional_gate.matrix: M_W(t,n)=w(n/L)n^(it) on the exact support L<n<2L
actual_log_conditional_gate.missing_statement: It is CONJECTURED, not proved here, that the RationalMass-relevant actual-Farey class forces the displayed mu_top and chi_ph bounds.

claim_boundary: This artifact proves a finite-dimensional rowwise phase-flatness lemma for the actual CRR matrix conditional on explicit row statistics, and scoped abstract countermodels. It proves neither AFARI/FARI/CFARI nor CRR-U, a compatible witness, a cubic estimate, a density gain, a short-interval theorem, a saturation theorem, or an L-function result.

exact_sample.scope: abstract finite matrix only; not asserted to be a Dirichlet measurement matrix

countermodel_phase_cancellation.properties: lambda=1, fixed spectral gap 74/243, equal row diagonal 206/243, rho=169/412, mu_top=1, chi_ph=1, but phi=0 by exact row cancellation

falsifiers.actual_gate: An orientation error in M_W(t,n), a changed coefficient cap, a changed W, or a generic-alias replacement would invalidate the CRR conditional gate.
falsifiers.block_countermodel: An algebraic failure of positive definiteness, equal diagonal, top singular-vector construction, or the stated rational phi/participation bounds refutes that scoped countermodel.
falsifiers.lemma: A finite matrix violating the displayed decomposition, orthogonality identity, or phase-flatness lower bound refutes the lemma.

necessity_boundary.coordinatewise_leakage: The cancellation family has mu_top=1 but chi_ph=1 and phi=0, so a global spectral-gap or averaged-residual bound cannot by itself give an all-row lower bound.
necessity_boundary.minimum_leverage: When r=0, phi^2=mu_top exactly, so global participation cannot replace minimum top leverage.
necessity_boundary.next_target: An actual-Farey inverse theorem must exploit the actual logarithmic matrix/Farey interaction to establish mu_top and chi_ph, or solve the exact phase program directly.

phase_flatness_lemma.decomposition: M b^ph=||x||_1*sqrt(lambda)*u+r with r=M(b^ph-||x||_1*x) and ||M b^ph||_2^2=lambda||x||_1^2+||r||_2^2
phase_flatness_lemma.scope: valid for every finite complex matrix; its CRR use below retains the actual M_W and one common W
